subject: Invoice tranche migration: cross-entity tax routing discrepancy
messages:
From: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@heliumcloud.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: accounts@heliumcloud.com
Date: Wed, 29 Nov 2028 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Discrepancy on invoice 8893 - tax routing shows wrong entity

Hi Marcus,

We received invoice 8893 for our November usage but our AP team flagged that the invoice shows tax routing to Redwood US (entity RED-NA) instead of Redwood EU (entity RED-EU). Because our local VAT reclaim depends on the supplier entity, we have to hold payment until this is corrected.

I attached the invoice and a screenshot from our portal showing how it was routed. Can your billing team confirm whether this is an invoicing config issue (entity mapping) or if this is a downstream posting in your AR ledger?

We can process a short-term credit if needed, but would prefer a corrected invoice and a one-line journal adjusting the AR allocation so our AP can close the PO.

Thanks,
Sara Lopez
Head of Finance Operations
Helium Cloud

Attachment: invoice_8893_heliumcloud.pdf (PDF, 342KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@heliumcloud.com>
Cc: lauren.bennett@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 03 Dec 2028 14:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on invoice 8893 - tax routing shows wrong entity

Hi Sara — thanks for the callout and the attachment. I pulled the billing config and it looks like the invoicing engine emitted the correct supplier entity on the PDF (RED-EU), but our AR posting pipeline re-routed the receipt to the RED-NA AR bucket during the invoice ingest/GL mapping step.

Short version: invoice PDF = RED-EU, ledger = RED-NA. That mismatch explains the VAT reclaim problem on your side.

Lauren and Grace — tagging you for the ledger export and a proposed journal entry to move the outstanding balance from RED-NA AR to RED-EU AR so Helium can receive a corrected invoice and close their PO.

Suggested next steps:
- Grace: pull the NetLedger export for 2028-11 (GL export attached) and confirm the posting (invoice 8893, customer = HELIUMCLOUD, AR account currently GL 1102-REDNA).
- Lauren: draft the reversing / reclass journal we can post this week and a corrected invoice PDF to re-send to the customer.

Sara — we can either re-issue the invoice (corrected PDF) and post a reclass journal in our books, or issue a short credit + new invoice if you prefer. Which is easier for your AP?

Marcus
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: netledger_export_2028-12-05.csv (CSV, 21KB)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, lauren.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 04 Dec 2028 11:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on invoice 8893 - tax routing shows wrong entity

Thanks Marcus — I extracted the row from the GL export. Filing as quoted below for traceability.

"8893", "HELIUMCLOUD", "2028-11-30", "1102-REDNA", "AR", "EUR", "34,560.00"

The invoice was indeed posted to 1102-REDNA (AR bucket for US entity). I checked the mapping rules and the downstream mapper incorrectly matched the customer domain (heliumcloud.com) to an old partner mapping that defaults to RED-NA. That mapping should have been retired in July.

Proposed journal (for posting on Dec 6):
- Dr 1102-REDNA (AR) EUR 34,560.00
- Cr 1999-SUSPENSE (Clearing) EUR 34,560.00

Then run a second re-posting journal to move from 1999-SUSPENSE to 1105-REDEU (AR) once the corrected invoice is re-issued:
- Dr 1999-SUSPENSE EUR 34,560.00
- Cr 1105-REDEU (AR) EUR 34,560.00

AR impact: net AR unchanged, moves balance across entity-ledgers so tax reporting aligns.

Lauren — can you prepare the corrected invoice PDF with entity RED-EU and the supplier VAT references? I can schedule the two journals on Dec 6 (will document GL entry IDs and post times).

Grace
Sr. Accounting Operations
Redwood Inference

To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@heliumcloud.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 06 Dec 2028 15:43:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on invoice 8893 - tax routing shows wrong entity

Hi all — quick update and confirmation of actions taken.

1) Corrected invoice: re-issued PDF attached (invoice_8893_heliumcloud_corrected.pdf). Supplier entity now shows Redwood EU (RED-EU) and includes the EU VAT number and local tax language.
2) Journals posted:
   - JE ID: JE-2028-1212A (posted 2028-12-06 09:15 UTC)
     Dr 1102-REDNA AR EUR 34,560.00
     Cr 1999-SUSPENSE EUR 34,560.00
   - JE ID: JE-2028-1212B (posted 2028-12-06 10:02 UTC)
     Dr 1999-SUSPENSE EUR 34,560.00
     Cr 1105-REDEU AR EUR 34,560.00
3) Notifications sent to Helium Cloud AP (accounts@heliumcloud.com). Please process the corrected invoice 8893 (same invoice number, corrected supplier entity) — no net change to amount due.

Sara — please confirm once your AP reopens/clears the PO so we can close out the suspense flow. If you prefer a short credit instead of a re-issue, let me know and we can reverse and issue a credit note.

Thanks,
Lauren Bennett
Revenue Accounting Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: invoice_8893_heliumcloud_corrected.pdf (PDF, 342KB)
